question: Which among the following is a subject of Union Lists in Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Extradition**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **subject among the given options that fall under the Union List in the Constitution of India is Extradition**
 
• In the Constitution of India, the** seventh schedule classifies the subjects of legislation into three lists: Union, State, and Concurrent.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Seventh Schedule** of the Indian constitution gives allocation of powers and functions between the **Union & States.**
 
• **It contains 3 lists:**

 
• Union List (For central Govt) 100 Subjects (originally 97).
 
• States List (Powers of State Govt) 61 subjects (originally 66). 
 
• Concurrent List (Both Union & States) 52 subjects (originally 47).

 
• **Union List: Union Legislature alone can make laws on these matters.**

 
 
• Defence
 
• Atomic Energy
 
• Foreign Affairs
 
• War and Peace
 
• Banking
 
• Railways
 
• Post and Telegraph
 
• Airways
 
• Ports
 
• Foreign Trade
 
• Currency & Coinage
 
 
 
• **State List: State Legislature can make laws on these matters (though it sometimes has exceptions).**
 
 
• Agriculture
 
• Police
 
• Prison
 
• Local Government
 
• Public Health
 
• Land
 
• Liquor
 
• Trade and Commerce
 
• Livestock and Animal Husbandry
 
• State Public Services
 
 
 
• **Concurrent List: Both Union and State Legislature alone can make laws on these matters. **
 
 
• Education
 
• Transfer of Property other than Agricultural land
 
• Forests
 
• Trade Unions
 
• Adulteration
 
• Adoption and Succession
